summary: Implementation plan for restructuring the curriculum into 32 sessions (Session 1: 6 new; Sessions 2-32: 3 new + 3 cumulative random review = 6 exam questions), showing only new questions in the Study tab, re-sampling review questions from Sessions 1..(n-1) on every Exam entry and Exam Reset, renaming "일차" to "회차", and rounding 6-question exam scores (5/6 = 83 points, pass >= 80).
